name: Science eval v2
description: Runs all 120 items of eval-science-v2 at temperature 0 and reports accuracy overall, by category and by difficulty. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v3 id.

eval.notes: Applied physics and chemistry with every constant pinned in the prompt; the hard items are multi-step chains, limiting-reagent traps and deliberate unit mismatches. Hard items ask for step-by-step work and a final 'Answer: <number>' line, which is why max_output_tokens is 4096.

notes: Part of the -v2 eval generation, built to spread models that saturate the v1 suites. accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right.
